props.title: transform
props.description: Review target for the Inputs row punctuation toggle

callouts.text: 1 · Select this Block. Its Inputs panel reads 'count : int = 0' — monospace, muted ':' and '='. The new default.
2 · ≡ menu → Settings → Appearance → 'Inputs row style'. Toggle 'Code-style Inputs row' OFF — today's plain row: no punctuation, Name in the sans-serif font.
3 · Toggle it back ON. The row returns to name: type = default. Port values are untouched either way.
PASS WHEN · the row reads name: type = default by default, the toggle switches it to the plain row and back, and port values never change.
